headline: 2 army personnel killed, 1 critical: PM visits injured army officer at CMH
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman visited the Combined Military Hospital to check on an officer critically injured in a tank-firing accident during a field exercise in Hathazari.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman visited the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) on Friday afternoon to check on an army officer who was critically injured in a tank-firing accident.
The incident occurred on Wednesday during a Bangladesh Army field-firing exercise in Hathazari, Chattogram, while a tank was firing shells.
Two army personnel were killed in the accident, while the officer visited by the PM sustained serious injuries and is currently receiving treatment at CMH.
During the visit, the Prime Minister enquired about the patient's condition, spoke with the officer and his family members, and wished him a speedy recovery.
Tarique Rahman instructed the hospital authorities to ensure the officer receives the best possible treatment.
The Prime Minister also expressed deep sorrow over the deaths of the two army personnel and conveyed his condolences to their families.
caption:
Two army personnel killed and one officer critically injured in a tank-firing accident during a field exercise in Hathazari.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman visited the Combined Military Hospital (CMH) on Friday afternoon to check on an army officer who was critically injured in a tank-firing accident.

The incident occurred on Wednesday during a Bangladesh Army field-firing exercise in Hathazari, Chattogram, while a tank was firing shells.

Two army personnel were killed in the accident, while the officer visited by the PM sustained serious injuries and is currently receiving treatment at CMH.

During the visit, the Prime Minister enquired about the patient's condition, spoke with the officer and his family members, and wished him a speedy recovery.

Tarique Rahman instructed the hospital authorities to ensure the officer receives the best possible treatment.

The Prime Minister also expressed deep sorrow over the deaths of the two army personnel and conveyed his condolences to their families.

headline: 63 foreign nationals arrested in Chittagong over online fraud
summary: Police raided a building in the Khulshi area, busting an international online fraud ring operating from a single location.
details: The Counter Terrorism Unit (CTU) of the city police and Khulshi police station police arrested 63 foreign nationals from a building in the Khulshi area of Chittagong city.
The suspects were allegedly operating an international online fraud ring from the premises.
Police reported that the suspects were using various electronic devices to carry out their fraudulent activities.
Some reports indicate the the suspects were also allegedly running a casino operation within the building.
The arrested individuals are being questioned to determine the nature and extent of their fraudulent activities and the network they are part of.
caption:
63 foreign nationals arrested in a single raid! Police bust an international online fraud ring in Chittagong.

The Counter Terrorism Unit (CTU) of the city police and Khulshi police station police arrested 63 foreign nationals from a building in the Khulshi area of Chittagong city.

The suspects were allegedly operating an international online fraud ring from the premises.

Police reported that the suspects were using various electronic devices to carry out their fraudulent activities.

Some reports indicate the the suspects were also allegedly running a casino operation within the building.

The arrested individuals are being questioned to determine the nature and extent of their fraudulent activities and the network they are part of.
